technique_name: Create a cover letter addressing why the applicant is a perfect fit for the job.
description:
I am writing to apply for the position of Management Consultant. With my background in business administration and a focus on management, I am confident that I have the qualifications necessary to make a positive contribution to your organization.

As a management consultant, I have extensive experience in developing solutions to improve organizational performance. I am adept at conducting analysis, identifying opportunities for improvement, and ensuring that change initiatives are successful. A
example: I have completed my Masters in Business Administration with focus on management.
